title: Structural variation is invisible to SNP-distance dereplication: the reference strain of Yersinia pestis merges with its own attenuated derivative
description: Analysis code, derived tables and figure scripts for a study of reference-relative measurements in Yersinia pestis comparative genomics: reference-based quality metrics act as divergence filters, a SNP distance over jointly called sites cannot see a 102.6 kb deletion, and absence relative to the reference has unknown polarity. Contains the Snakemake pipeline, the six figure scripts, every derived table, results/numbers.json plus docs/NUMBER_REGISTRY.md mapping every number in the Results to the file and code version that produced it, the supplementary tables, and the second-reference replication.
notes: Licence split: code is MIT (LICENSE); derived tables and figures are CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA). Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23353814; this version (v1.0.0) DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23353815.
